amendment_reasons: Resolve source numeric presets and faithful D7 encoders/decoders before HPO
Warm-start each neural search with one source-backed LR/dropout under equal T12
Historical E1 recipe selection reachesOct31; purge7days before BOTH P1 and calibration
Preserve finalE1test60dates/metric/delta/anchors; evaluations remain exploratory because known
Use all20calibration predictors fixed before results, avoiding missing uncertainty for whichever Top3 is reported
Declare scratch checkpoint retention and development-only matched-R ablations before any fits

P1.recipes: Primary HPO recipes frozen from Jan-Oct31 development; actual primary recipes, not truncated surrogate

primary_test.primary_metric: mean per-seed RMSE in original sigma7 units

generalization_gap.scope: SecondaryA53 predictor trained and selected throughOct31; not a claim of no overfit of primaryDec24fit
generalization_gap.primary_test_minus_train_gap: separate descriptive temporal diagnostic; no extra decision family

equivalence_and_cost.reference: best of all20 by frozen common nested development Jan-Oct31; no test selection
equivalence_and_cost.rule: IUT max(TOST practical-equivalence p, lower-cost p), keep all19 hypotheses

predictive_PIT.test: centered calendar-block empirical process, randomized atoms; not IID KS

FWER_scope: The inherited0.05allocation controls only its30+30+199families under valid p-values; added exploratory families have their separately declared controls, not an all-analysis global0.05claim

ablation_design.model_selection: best Top10 by nested common development before final fits; identify separately if globalbestisaclassical
ablation_design.seeds: exact same R and seed prefix selected for primary final fits
ablation_design.streaming_schedule: All4Rjobs sealed before first ablation fit; each own checkpoint closes before its development score; allprimary/Afitclosures before first such score; no score-based changes; analysis after complete4Rpanel

posthoc_diagnostics_subset.explanations: Top3 by frozen nested development over all20; analytic/occlusion explanation for classical references
posthoc_diagnostics_subset.XAI_baseline: 35 training-only per-cell standardized means; preserve deterministic relative-window constants
posthoc_diagnostics_subset.secondary_XAI: Integrated gradients only when completeness passes; same frozen baseline; otherwise reported not applicable

predictability_reference.method: Known sixD7logreturns plus empirical future innovation law from training2023only

volatility_secondary_metrics.VaR_test_applicability: Not claimed: realized-volatility forecasts do not specify a conditional return/VaR distribution

checkpoint_policy.HPO: after prediction closure keep config,curve,preprocessing,index,predictions,weights hash and pruning receipt; no unbounded checkpoint accumulation
checkpoint_policy.P1_primary_A: preserve until corresponding global freeze and scored prediction closure, no earlier payload unblinding
checkpoint_policy.ablation: development-scored scratch may be pruned with receipt; retain first seed4variant examples

power_approximation_limits.unpiloted_families: Upper-SD proxy (chi-square df9) inflated1.5 is conditional on a normal contrast approximation, not empirical final-recipe power certification
power_approximation_limits.latency_upper_SD: Chi-square df60 approximation from61timing blocks is conditional; CPU scheduling/hardware change invalidates direct transfer
power_approximation_limits.pilot_to_primary_calendar: 53 known development days project to60known historical test dates under stated stationarity/transfer assumptions; no creation of independent dates

runtime: requirements-e2-completion.lock.txt; CPU/FP32/one numerical thread per fresh fit; up to4workers on4CPU/32GiB; author source hashes bind112files including transitive layers and numeric presets

leakage_controls.permutation_unit: consecutive admitted daily observations, including a moved final partial block; gaps reported, never filled or relabeled
leakage_controls.permutation_scope: outer, inner-training and inner-validation labels independently permuted; inner stopping never uses unpermuted validation labels
leakage_controls.recipe: exact primary development-selected hyperparameters; independent negative-control weights, not a competitor or HPO candidate
leakage_controls.freeze_order: all primary+A+negative-control weights <= global closure < all calibrators closed < the single E2 test scoring phase
leakage_controls.regression_reference: constant original-scale training-target mean, not classification accuracy or an assumed zero score

diagnostic_family.gain_pvalue: centered paired circular-block bootstrap at the null boundary delta
diagnostic_family.association_null: no positive temporal association under block exchangeability
diagnostic_family.association_pvalue: block-permute evaluation targets, fixed control forecasts; one-sided Spearman
diagnostic_family.alert_rule: joint IUT Holm17 pvalue<alpha and observed gain>delta and observed Spearman>0

endogenous_reference_control.reason: ARIMA and naive forecasts explicitly consume only past target history; shuffling supervised OHLCV labels does not preserve their input contract
endogenous_reference_control.alternative: existing fixed-parameter causal state/support audits and controlled past-history perturbation curves, evaluated in the same sealed scoring phase

adversarial_validation.features: the35flattened seven-day OHLCV cells from the common frozen primary preprocessing; no target, outcome-derived covariate or calendar feature
adversarial_validation.classifier: fixed balanced logistic regression, scipy L-BFGS-B, L2coefficient.01, unpenalized intercept, maximum200iterations
adversarial_validation.heldout: one contiguous date chunk from each population per fold
adversarial_validation.scaler: mean/SD learned exclusively from each classifier training fold
adversarial_validation.score: pooled out-of-fold ROC AUC via Mann-Whitney ranks, tiecorrected; direction predeclared test=1
adversarial_validation.resampling: permute domain-label blocks and refit the entire cross-validation procedure for every replicate
adversarial_validation.CI: paired circular-block percentile bootstrap of frozen out-of-fold scores and domain labels
adversarial_validation.handling_if_shift: retain chronological evaluation, fixed A53 calibration and registered robustness analyses; explain change without reselection or retraining feedback

leakage_controls.status_before_execution: prospectively specified pending public registration and execution
